lines: The massive body of the Shinobi Bear fell to Shikanosuke's swift slash.
HahーWhat do you think of my deadly Darkness Thunder Blade?
Shikanosuke called out to the Shinobi Bears and the ninja who had collapsed to the ground behind him.
Of course, he still kept the cool pose as he stuck the landing after his strike.
My, my. Was it that effective?
But no need to worry. I won't take your lives.
If I did, and I was stained in darkness all the way to my soul, I would become the same as you villains...
Shikanosuke offhandedly talked about himself with a faraway look on his face.
Now go home and tell your boss that Uehara Shikanosuke doesn't run or hide. Go on and attack me wheー
Asuka and I had been closely watching the whole thing.
Go on and attack me whenev-... huh?
Shikanosuke seemed to have noticed us.
He was still in his cool pose with a self-satisfied look on his face, but his expression slowly turned into one that seemed to be saying, "Huh? What?"
Yeah, it's me. And this is Asuka, you've met her once before.
Asuka greeted him as if nothing had happened.
Sweat was pouring down Shikanosuke's face.
His look of "Huh? Isn't something weird?" was getting stronger with each moment.
Um...? So what exactly is going on...?
I don't exactly know the details, butー
According to Asuka, it looks like we are trapped in a world that gives shape to our fantasies.
But man, you had these kinds of over-the-top middle-schooler wishes...?
What was it you said? The Devildomian Power sealed within your left arm? The "Dark Lightning Taimanin" who summons lightning of darkness...?
That was... err...  totally cool, yeah...
Shikanosuke screamed and his face turned bright red.
He seemed to have finally become aware that we had seen him in a ridiculously embarrassing moment.
No, don't worry. All men go through that kind of phase. You know what I mean, right, Asuka?
Hmmm. To be honest, I'm not really sure, but I guess that's just what boys do?
Uwaaaaaaaaaaahhh!! I'm getting vague moral support from someone I barely knooooooow!!
Shikanosuke was making a scene as he blew a fuse.
He was panicking over the fact that he had revealed a dark part of his history...
And it took quite a while for him to calm down enough to be able to speak properlyー
